title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Line Graph – Household Recycling Rates
prompt: The line graph below shows the percentage of household waste recycled in four different cities (A, B, C, and D) between 2005 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请根据折线图描述四个城市家庭垃圾回收率的变化趋势，并比较它们之间的差异。写作时请确保至少150词，并涵盖图表中的主要特征和比较。
